# DivyaYagyam (divyayagyam.com)
> Authentic Online Puja Bookings, Vedic Rituals & Spiritual Guidance in India.

## About DivyaYagyam
DivyaYagyam is India's leading digital platform for booking authentic online pujas, yajnas, and astrology services directly from sacred temples (Kashi Vishwanath, Mahakaleshwar Ujjain, Somnath, Trimbakeshwar). Guided by Pandit Mukesh Bohra (35+ years of Vedic experience), every ritual features personalized Name-Gotra Sankalp, video proof sent via WhatsApp, and home delivery of consecrated (Abhimantrit) Prasad.

## Core Devotional Services
- [Online Pujas](https://divyayagyam.com/pujas): Book Rudrabhishek, Kaal Sarp Dosh, and Mahamrityunjay Jaap online.
- [VIP Rituals](https://divyayagyam.com/vip-pujas): Special long-form ceremonies and exclusive family sankalp.
- [BhaktiSeva Offerings](https://divyayagyam.com/bhaktiseva): Offer sacred chadhawa and offerings directly to holy temples.
- [Sacred Products & Prasad](https://divyayagyam.com/products): 100% authentic Abhimantrit Rudraksha, Yantras, and Puja Samagri.
- [Vedic Astrology Tools](https://divyayagyam.com/tools): Free online Kundali, Kundali Milan, Daily Panchang, and Shubh Muhurat calculators.
- [Spiritual Blog](https://divyayagyam.com/blog): In-depth articles on Sanatan Dharma, mantras, Vrat Katha, and Vedic traditions.
